name: codeboss
description: CodeBoss2: orchestrates Claude Code headless from Cowork via a supervisor pattern. Claude Code runs on the user's machine (Windows: Task Scheduler; macOS: nohup) and reports back into the supervising Cowork session with `claude -p "[code]: ..." --cloud <session-id>` - Anthropic's session ingress, authenticated with the machine's claude.ai login. No UI automation.
